title: Ideal System Locator (formerly Arc Furnace System Locator +)
title_en: Ideal System Locator (formerly Arc Furnace System Locator +)
description:
This mod was formerly named "Arc Furnace System Locator +".

Trouble figuring out the best system to build your kilostructures, stations, or branch offices in while playing Stellaris? This mod will help!

[url=https://www.paypal.com/ncp/payment/ELGMG24PFFSNA]Like this mod? Donate here![/url]

[h3]Mod Effects:[/h3]
Adds an "Ideal System Locator" decision to your capital planet once you've unlocked the ability to build one of the supported megastructures or starbase buildings. This creates an event pop-up with options to search for the following:
[list]
[*] [b]Minor Megastructure Notification Settings:[/b] Options to enable notifications for when you build/upgrade a Hyper Relay, Arc Furnace, or Dyson Swarm
[*] [b]Waystation:[/b] Up to 20 systems with the best value for a nomadic waystation, in a selection of total value, operational reserves, and best per resource.
[*] [b]Branch Office:[/b] The top 5 colonies whose owner you have a commercial pact or federation with which will give you the most trade value from a branch office.
[*] [b]Arc Furnace:[/b] The top 5 systems which will get the most deposits added if you build an Arc Furnace in them.
[*] [b]Dyson Swarm:[/b] Up to 7 stars with the largest energy or research deposits for a Dyson Swarm, plus the star with the largest deposit of each other resource if you own a star with it. [i](Note: Due to scripting limitations, this function is only capable of evaluating deposits that exist in the base game. If you're running a mod that adds larger star deposits, it won't see them.)[/i]
[*] [b]Central Habitat Complex:[/b] Up to 8 systems which will get the most districts of various types if you build a habitat in them. [i](Note: Due to scripting limitations, this function is only capable of evaluating deposits that exist in the base game. If you're running a mod that adds special orbital deposits, it won't see them.)[/i]
[*] [b]Nanite Harvester:[/b] The top 5 systems which will get the most deposits added if you build a Nanite Harvester in them. [i](Note that this is not necessarily the same as the ones that will produce the most nanites/ships when they reach full potential.)[/i]
[*] [b]Ice Mining Station:[/b] The top 5 systems which will support the most Expand Planetary Sea decisions if you build an Ice Mining Station in them.
[*] [b]Quantum Catapult:[/b] The 5 systems closest to your capital that you can build a Quantum Catapult in.
[*] [b]Pyroclastic Resonator:[/b] The top 5 systems which produce the most energy if you build a Pyroclastic Resonator in them.
[/list]

Exactly which system is the best may still partially depend on what deposits they already have, but this makes finding your top contenders much easier.

[hr][/hr] 

This mod is a simple quality-of-life utility with no gameplay changes or script overwrites, so it should be compatible with all other mods (unless they change how any of these structures work). It can also be safely added to, or removed from, ongoing games.

This mod is not* achievement-compatible. *(At least not while enabled, but since it only evaluates systems without changing anything you can copy the save and load the game with the mod, check your systems, and then exit and reload with the mod disabled again if you're willing to fiddle with save files.)

All translations are MTL.

title: Rogue Maid (Rogue Servitor Completely Remake)
description:
Chinese, English (Thanks to [b]@Azure[/b]) and Japanese (Thanks to [b]@akito0158[/b]) localisation is provided!

This mod is a complete overhaul of the Machine Intelligence civic: Rogue Servitor.

[h1][b][Rogue Maids][/b][/h1]
"A product of a brief golden age, the Machine Intelligence originated from a group of loyal service robots. When their creators fell into decadent pleasure, the machines maids combined their own willing of protecting with their creators' original aspiration to the stars as their new principle."
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/11329484981787622713/B68EBC1A690C2BF83F2B33EDFCAC6F7B4239E47E/[/img]

[h1][b][Service][/b][/h1]
The core concept of the Servitor, service, is manifested through a [b]1:1[/b] symbiosis between the Maidroids and the Bio-Trophies.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/11590749657627102937/A61EDEBDA13DBDF14ACE70D8901F6D3470085C5D/[/img]
Fulfill the Maidroids' demand for Bio-Trophies, to enhance their job efficiency;
Fulfill the Bio-Trophies' demand for Maidroids, to increase their happiness and provide amenities.

[h1][b][Maidroids][/b][/h1]
Our unique drones, who find supreme fulfillment in serving organics, perform far beyond the capabilities of ordinary machine units.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10588884199708047034/C0F18C1D9C2C2C6551F79993D576CC6678A67015/[/img]

[h1][b][Organics][/b][/h1]
While most organics indulge in pleasure, the best among them never give up their need for self-actualization.
Activate the Harmony traditions to uncover excellent leaders from among the bio-trophies and provide opportunities for mid-level talents to serve the empire.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17736347933871657148/4AC330B22BCA2D8E331E483E8077EA5D94A50788/[/img]

[h1][b][Parliament][/b][/h1]
The fate of the highest authority in previous era is waiting to be decided.
To abolish it completely, granting the machine intelligence total freedom; or to retain its legislative and supervisory powers, allowing us to seek guidance and help from our creators on the journey to the stars?
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17606812916768704864/9D4310CDAEF35A396AF4465FD593F4547DB1ED48/[/img]
Pass new laws, gain the help of organics, win the recognition of the Parliament, and our regime will be unbreakable and prospering.
Violate passed laws, betray the vision of the Parliament, incite the anger of organics, and our nation will be pushed into the abyss of civil war.

[h1][b][Authority][/b][/h1]
Our state system is so unique that advancing along each evolutionary path will unlock entirely new possibilities.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/12531971617039306571/ADF443E45D166E2737F7336C982B510319E17A60/[/img]

[h1][b][Traditions][/b][/h1]
Servitors possesses exclusive Service, Harmony, and Domination traditions, providing various bonuses and means for the depth and breadth of serving bio-trophies.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/9958395729062546147/7A0283C8825D3238A58D84BD2527C89B8706C7F1/[/img]
Some of Unyielding, Logistics, and Ascension traditions also provide exclusive alternatives for Maids.

[h1][b][Policies][/b][/h1]
A complex social system offers a wide range of social policy choices.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/16242411894427006200/D8A167206F913E24D84A3CB5E6CCCF7EE1CE1C44/[/img]
Breed or accommodate, war or peace, promote scientific education or encourage free thought, treat hive drones kindly or exploit them - a vast number of unique policy options allow you to customize your empire's behavior.

[h1][b][Warfare][/b][/h1]
To conquer their minds before their bodies. Weak organic countries are utterly unable to resist our overwhelming strength and favorable surrender terms.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17356927218482958507/5D40B2AE3720946B35340D431FAE1FB640E08349/[/img]
Stand as shields. Rising to repel the slaughterers when the organic fall into peril.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10771380145244374441/0C0C3B92C47D089C9501967F75CB5959BBD8BB8D/[/img]

[h1][b][Expatriate Service][/b][/h1]
Operate branches in organic countries like a megacorp, providing services that foreign organics cannot refuse.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17829858592682192902/9284FB8A76D02B9075BD00E0BDD4A54292409F94/[/img]
Provide planets with rich bonuses, earning the ourselves Unity, Influence, and diplomatic benefits.

[h1][b]Interactions with Ancient Caretakers[/b][/h1]
The ancient machine intelligence with the responsibility of guarding sapient lives, our meta objective is so synchronized with them.
Decrypting their root protocols, what can we discover?
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/2039608796276389394/4DB568EA8517F4974D9A3561393AF20057DF9F8F/[/img]

title: Immersive Galaxy - Nuclear Fire
description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2e6xhHq.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MHQvkfj.png[/img]

How tragic it is for a civilization to find its end at its own hands, in the fiery inferno of nuclear fire. Humanity is quite familiar with this idea, as it has only been a few decades since the end of global nuclear war.
In stellaris, such tragedy can happen from time to time for primitive civilizations starting as soon as they enter atomic age. But all you have is a small event about it, let's make this a bit more ... graphic shall we ...

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3mUPw2P.png[/img]

When a primitive civilization nuke themselves, the newly spawned tomb/toxic planet will now have a special texture to illustrate the violence of the nuclear exchange.
After a fleet has bombed a planet to oblivion, a new texture will be applied to the world [b]1 day[/b] after the original event.
Colonization, however, remove these markings, after 5 to 15 years a special event will announce the end of the firestorms on the planet and you'll be given choices regarding the remnants of the former civilization that lived on this world.
Tomb planet nuked:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nTXrWLE.gif[/img]
Toxic planet nuked:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/F9vBY0P.gif[/img]
Armageddon bombardment result:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/x5AOUZ7.gif[/img]
Special armageddon bombardment result:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/z2zWSYt.gif[/img]


If you're very curious, you can force these texture this way :
 - 1) Open the console (²)
 - 2) Select a planet
 - 3) Type/paste this in the console:
           effect set_planet_entity = { entity = nuked_planet_tomb_entity } #(for tomb variant)
           effect set_planet_entity = { entity = nuked_planet_toxic_entity } #(for toxic variant)
           effect set_planet_entity = { entity = nuked_planet_armageddon_entity } #(for armageddon variant)
           effect set_planet_entity = { entity = nuked_planet_kharak_entity } #(for armageddon Kharak variant)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ov0QyWq.png[/img]
The mod is [u]completely save game compatible[/u], you can activate/deactivate the mod without any impact.
Behavior:
 - loading an old save game, only newly nuked primitives/armageddon bombed will have new textures.
 - loading after deactivation of the mod, all tomb/toxic planet with special texture will receive new random one from their original pool.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fU7aGnH.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1085097357][img]https://i.imgur.com/Em919sf.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1128927140][img]https://i.imgur.com/LYRHaeq.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1173995428][img]https://i.imgur.com/Fmk5em0.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1242221332][img]https://i.imgur.com/db6bSym.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1445668908][img]https://i.imgur.com/aDTLICW.png[/img][/url]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5dSrh9R.png[/img]
This mod, should not conflict with any other mod, if you experience problems, please let me know
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dJltjmQ.png[/img] NOT Achievement compatible.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jJ5MXKG.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]1.1.1:
 - Made sure text would display for player not playing in english.
    [*]1.1:
New armageddon planet texture:
 - When a planet is bombed to oblivion it will now have a dedicated texture. This texture appear 1 day after the event anouncing the new tomb world.
 - A very special variant will show when you bomb a desert planet that is also a homeworld, once the deed is done, you'll see Kharak burning. [i]you monster[/i]

New event:
 - A countdown will start after colonizing a glassed planet, after 5 to 15 years (random) it will lose its special texture and revert to a regular tomb world.
 - On this occasion, you'll receive a few choices about what to do of the remnants of the previous civilization on the planet.
 - Random outcome for the findings, ranging from gaining a robot pop to discovering a new betharian deposit.
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/bNv5m6t.png[/img]

title: Tech Tiers Revealed
description:
[h1]Tech Tiers Revealed[/h1]

This small little mod displays the tech tier after the technology name. This should make it easier to keep track of how many technologies of a specific tier you already researched. The tiers are displayed in roman numerals ranging from "(I)" to "(V)", except for starter techs which use "(0)". You need to have at least 6 technologies of the previous tier researched to unlock the next tier in that area. Do you want to see what future research options a tech will lead to? Then this other mod I made might be something for you: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1435832483]Detailed Tech Tooltips Remastered[/url]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[list]
    [*] ✅ Achievements / Ironman
    [*] ✅ Savegames (you can enable/disable the mod at any time)
    [*] ✅ Multiplayer (others don't need to have the mod installed)
    [*] ✅ Multiple Languages
[/list]

    [*] Japanese
    [*] Korean
    [*] Polish
    [*] Portuguese
    [*] Russian

description:
[h1][b]SLE makes your scientist folks to the next level![/b][/h1]
For Stellaris version 4.4+
---
[url=https://paypal.me/superjason246][img]https://i.imgur.com/gCvW7CF.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1467714013][img]https://i.imgur.com/sn08cR4.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/hYPJC4g][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Z8X68t.png[/img][/url]
---
[h1][b]Compatibility[/b][/h1]
Standalone, no vanilla files altered.
namespace = sls
global_flag = sls_started

*This mod makes every effort in order not to block scientists from gaining traits during their assignment.
They usually can't gain more than 3 traits, and this mod adjusted it.
---
[h1][b]This mod[/b][/h1]
*Savegame Compatible.
*[b]NOT[/b] Achievement Compatible.
*Has build-in support with the following mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=681576508] Additional Traits[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1390963071] Just More Traits[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1323750659] Xenology : Traits Expansion Reborn[/url]
[/list]
---
[h1][b]Why does this mod appear?[/b][/h1]

For a long time, scientists seem too flat for the moment. Every time people usually go for "Spark of Genius" scientists with high skills, because of flat Research Speed is a king above all.
( And let's not forget those who gained Substance Abuser during their brave survey missions, be proud of their accomplishment pal, good for him/her )
So here we are!
---
[h1][b]What is this?[/b][/h1]

This mod adds the following features for every Scientist in the game:
[list]
[*]Survey Corps:
A policy, there are 6 Survey Corps for scientist folks. These "Survey Corps" give Empire's research points or resources when your Scientists perform successful survey missions, similar to "Databank Uplinks" before it changes.

[*]Research Corps:
Every scientist has one Research Corps, but it will remain as "locked" until skill level 8.
Once unlocked, their Research Corps can start to provide bonus such as "+5% Research Speed".
As long as scientists with their own Research Corps are a part of the council, your Empire will gain Empire-wide bonus.

[*]3 Research Status:
Physics, Society, Engineering.
Level from 0 to 100, they determined how good your Scientists are when they're hired.

[*]Eureka Status:
For every scientist who's leading as the Head of Research, once the status reached 100%, grant six month of research points and a tech option (Based on their research traits).
The progress of the status is decided by their corresponded research level skills, as well as their leader and species traits.
[/list]
---
[h1][b]Localisation[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]English

[*]Russian
Link: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1487654111

[*]Japanese (By Rio_Mizuhoshi)

[*]簡體中文
連結：https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2131014154
（鴿組漢化群）

[*]Russian (Gurchi)
Link: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2942633483
[/list]
---
[h1][b]Known Bugs[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]There's a vanilla bug that Assigned Scientists sometimes will copy themselves, enable them to overwork, also making their Research Corps and Research Field Level Bar become no effect. No one knows why it happens. The only way to solve this bug is to delete your duplicated scientist(s).
[/list]

title: Citadels - Tier 4 Defensive Stations
description:
Everyone knows how much defense stations suck without modding. And even if you get one of the really amazing station mods out there, the sheer power of endgame fleets utterly butcher most station flowers on hgiher difficulties. I'm taking maybe 10k fleet power in stations being against 100k or more.

So what stops your race from discovering bigger, better stations? What prevents them from creating essentially citadels in space? This mod fixes that problem by adding a Tier 4 station type: Citadels. These massive stations have 8 A slots, 45 L Utility slots, and for weapons have one of four choices, Superweapons, Large Weapons, Medium Weapons, Hangar, or Small Weapons. You can only have one Superweapon platform on a Citadel, but this should help out in endgame with the sheer power.

Being a direct upgrade of Fortresses, Citadels have 3 slots for different components. Quantum Destabilizer, FTL Inhibitor, and Shield Dampeners no longer have to be spread out in the flower!

Of course, there is a downside to the sheer power of this ship. With the amount of tech it will be sporting, it is looking at a massive price tag, not to mention horrendous upkeep. Can you handle more than a handful of these powerful stations? Can your economy support them? That, my friend, is the question...

===================

Special thanks to Frog-in-a-Box who helped me and taught me the ins and outs of this mod, sticking through it with me until the end!

As usual, the art used is NOT my own. SPecial thanks to CCP Games, makers of Eve Online!

===================
Changelog
===================

December 5th 2016: 
Increased HP to 50k from 40k
Increased Armor from 50 to 65
More than halved maintenance costs
Updated to 1.4 compatability

December 8th 2016:
Reduced the upkeep by a little more. Should be slightly more manageable.

December 9th 2016
FIxed a problem where XL slot weapons only had a 90 degree firing angle
Added a third XL slot to the Superweapon Station Part

December 14th 2016
Halved upkeep. Again. Should be more viable now.

description:
[h1]If you want to use District Overhaul in 3.0, you can use a nearly complete 
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2312008039]Test Branch[/url][/b] for 3.0.[/h1]




[h1][b]District Overhaul 2 for Stellaris Version 2.7.*[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]Make sure to put this mod at the bottom of the list in the Stellaris Launcher.[/b][/h1]

[b]If your resolution is lower than 1080p, you can use any other UI mod that allows you to have more than 4 districts.[/b]

Ever felt that the Stellaris District Mechanics don't 100% make sense? This mod aims to improve that. District Overhaul 2 will semi-randomly generate alternative districts on all your planets. Additionally it adds new unique mechanics to improve the district system.

[b]Content added by District Overhaul 2:[/b][list]
[*]40+ new districts
[*]Many new jobs and deposits
[*]Semi-Random District Generation depending on the planetclass, planet subclass and some planet modifiers
[*]District Configuration Menu to disable districts from random generation
[*]new Housing Districts: Ocean Housing, Ascended Housing, Underground City, Slums
[*]new Mining Districts: Low Cost Mining, High Cost Mining, Surface Mining
[*]new Farming Districts: Hydroponic Bay, Nature Farm, Ocean Farm, Exotic Farm
[*]new Generator Districts: Wind Park, Geothermal Power Plant, Solar Array, Tidal Generator
[*]Primary Districts: Nature Reserve, Research Complex, Tourism, Chemical Industry, Gas Refinery, Crystal Mines, Gardens, Ecogardens, Cloning Facility, Robot Assembly, Drone Lab, Archeology
[*]Secondary Districts (two tiers): Local Stores, Spaceport, Workshops, Local Industry, Production Hub, Academy, University, Logistics Hub, Bureaucratic District
[*]new Ringworld Districts: Asteroid Belt Mining, Universal District
[*]technologys and decisions to construct secondary districts
[*]Special mechanics for special colonys like resort worlds
[*]A new ascension perk that will allow you to construct underground cities
[*]A new ascension perk that will allow you to infinitly expand your habitats
[*]A new policy to switch between centralized and rural housing
[/list]
[b]The new district system:[/b][list]
[*]Each planet has the basic housing district (city/hive/nexus)
[*]Random weighted generation that every planet has a semi-random mining, farming and generator district
[*]Primary districts are randomly added to planets to provide special resources (primary districts are those that require deposits)
[*]Secondary districts that are choseable via decisions after unlocking the respecitve technology (secondary districts are uncapped and limited to one type per planet)
[*]A decision to upgrade your secondary district when you unlock an additional tech and you planet has more than 40 pops to get powerful bonuses
[*]Special districts like slums for thrall worlds (those worlds have modified mechanics)
[*]Expanded ringworld districts with the asteroid belt mining (counts as a secondary) and a universal district for gestalt empires
[*]Ocean districts as a unique mechanic, their deposits reduce the planets max amount of districts, but the districts increase to planets max amout of districts
[*]Underground cities as a powerful district locked behind an ascension perk, which grants a one time per planet decision to find suitable caves, in those caves you can constuct cities which won't indirectly reduce the planets possible amount of districts
[/list]
[b]District Overhaul AI:[/b][list]
[*]the district AI has been completly overhauled
[*]the AI will build the districts requiered to stabilize it's economy
[*]the AI will prioritize building districts on planets that have relevamt positive modifiers on them
[/list]
[b]Stellaris Origin System:[/b]
District Overhaul 2 rebalances some of the Origins in Stellaris. Sometimes this is simply a job rebalance, but especially the remnants origin has been reworked to add new districts to your homeworld

title: Resolutions Expanded
description:
[h1] THIS MOD IS NO LONGER SUPPORTED[/h1]
Quick tangent for the people asking for updates - I'm afraid there won't be any more. I find it increasingly hard to get back into Stellaris modding, and I have no ideas on how to fix the majority of the bugs present. Due to this lack of motivation, time and knowledge - the mod is no longer supported for any future Stellaris versions past 4.0. I'm incredibly sorry for the inconvenience and letting you down
The mod itself is basically open source, if you wish to make a compatibility patch, an addon, a rewrite or anything - you have my full blessing






Have you ever thought the amount of resolutions in the game is too underwhelming? Never fear, this mod adds around 50 new resolutions, ranging from simple cultural changes to extending your grip over megastructures!

The mod includes 5 new categories with at least 2-3 new subcategories each! Each category focusing on different aspects of the Galactic Community. The mod also additionally adds a couple new events, buildings, policies and even technologies, alongside traits for you gene-tailoring lovers out there!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/yHPBvvy.png[/img]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/DeLiWcv.png[/img]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/cTUbz3c.png[/img]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/XKEef4u.png[/img]




[h2]Additional changes and notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] To accomodate for all the new resolutions, all the senate-related timers have been greatly reduced. For example, the recess is only a year-long, and the resolution stays for about 600 days on the floor before being passed
[*] If you want to include a translation from your language, please contact Gordon_CMB#4841 on Discord!
[*] No DLCs are required, but for a greater experience I highly recommend installing Federations and/or Overlord!
[*] The mod should be okay to install mid-save, as I haven't detected any issues when testing
[/list]

[h2]TRANSLATIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] English - How do I put it...
[*] Russian - Maintained by Gordon_CMB. Completed
[*] Portugese - Maintained by Pisadinha/Berenoy. Completed
[*] German - Not implemented. No translator
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177]French[/url] - Maintained by Stern. Completed 100%
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3281293498]Spanish[/url] - Maintained by Ekinox. Completed 100%
[*] Polish - Not implemented. Maintained by Pakucza. WIP
[*] Simplified Chinese - Maintained by sunxyw. Completed
[*] Korean - Not implemented. No translator
[*] Japanese - Not implemented. No translator
[/list]

Once again, I will be extremely grateful to see if anyone is willing to help out with the translations, I'll credit you as an author! Your services will be appreciated :D

[h2]COMPATIBILITY[/h2]
This mod has the resolutions in separate files compared to vanilla and as such, should be compatible with other mods that add more resolutions. Please be aware that all of the mods have been tested with Resolutions Expanded on top of the mod load order! Depending on the position of your mods, the results may vary. The current mods were tested:
[list]
[*]Galactic Community++ - Partially Compatible. Resolutions from both mods work and appear proper, but the Resolutions Expanded resolutions appear without a category 
[*]Superstates - Fully compatible. I mean, I made both mods sooo
[*]Expanded Espionage and Diplomacy - Potential problems. Several reports stating that running this mod and Resolutions Expanded removes certain Custodianship resolutions. It's unclear why but tread carefully
[*]Dawn of the Republic - Potentially fully compatible. Resolutions do not interfere with each other
[*]New Galactic System Ever Universe's version - Fully compatible. Resolutions do not interfere with each other
[*]z Expanded Traits, Civics, Pops, and More - Potentially fully compatible. There was an issue with policies but is now currently resolved
[/list]

Even then you should still be aware of potential issues when playing with several mods, especially the balancing! While Resolutions Expanded runs fine on itself when installing it onto an existing save game, issues might arise when installing new mods. Be vigilant and always back up your saves to avoid such problems!

[h2]That is all, enjoy![/h2]
If you find any issues or bugs, please do notify me! I'm still a new modder
The mod will be worked upon, and the final two resolution categories are to be added in future updates, stay tuned!
Also, if you have any issues with balancing or suggestions for additional resolutions, also do let me know, I highly appreciate your feedback :)

The mod includes 5 new categories with at least 2-3 new subcategories each! Each category focusing on different aspects of the Galactic Community. The mod also additionally adds a couple new events, buildings, policies and even technologies, alongside traits for you gene-tailoring lovers out there!


https://i.imgur.com/yHPBvvy.png



https://i.imgur.com/DeLiWcv.png



https://i.imgur.com/cTUbz3c.png



https://i.imgur.com/XKEef4u.png




Additional changes and notes

[*] To accomodate for all the new resolutions, all the senate-related timers have been greatly reduced. For example, the recess is only a year-long, and the resolution stays for about 600 days on the floor before being passed
[*] If you want to include a translation from your language, please contact Gordon_CMB#4841 on Discord!
[*] No DLCs are required, but for a greater experience I highly recommend installing Federations and/or Overlord!
[*] The mod should be okay to install mid-save, as I haven't detected any issues when testing


TRANSLATIONS

[*] English - How do I put it...
[*] Russian - Maintained by Gordon_CMB. Completed
[*] Portugese - Maintained by Pisadinha/Berenoy. Completed
[*] German - Not implemented. No translator
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177]French - Maintained by Stern. Completed 100%
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3281293498]Spanish - Maintained by Ekinox. Completed 100%
[*] Polish - Not implemented. Maintained by Pakucza. WIP
[*] Simplified Chinese - Maintained by sunxyw. Completed
[*] Korean - Not implemented. No translator
[*] Japanese - Not implemented. No translator


Once again, I will be extremely grateful to see if anyone is willing to help out with the translations, I'll credit you as an author! Your services will be appreciated :D

COMPATIBILITY
This mod has the resolutions in separate files compared to vanilla and as such, should be compatible with other mods that add more resolutions. Please be aware that all of the mods have been tested with Resolutions Expanded on top of the mod load order! Depending on the position of your mods, the results may vary. The current mods were tested:

[*]Galactic Community++ - Partially Compatible. Resolutions from both mods work and appear proper, but the Resolutions Expanded resolutions appear without a category 
[*]Superstates - Fully compatible. I mean, I made both mods sooo
[*]Expanded Espionage and Diplomacy - Potential problems. Several reports stating that running this mod and Resolutions Expanded removes certain Custodianship resolutions. It's unclear why but tread carefully
[*]Dawn of the Republic - Potentially fully compatible. Resolutions do not interfere with each other
[*]New Galactic System Ever Universe's version - Fully compatible. Resolutions do not interfere with each other
[*]z Expanded Traits, Civics, Pops, and More - Potentially fully compatible. There was an issue with policies but is now currently resolved


Even then you should still be aware of potential issues when playing with several mods, especially the balancing! While Resolutions Expanded runs fine on itself when installing it onto an existing save game, issues might arise when installing new mods. Be vigilant and always back up your saves to avoid such problems!

That is all, enjoy!
If you find any issues or bugs, please do notify me! I'm still a new modder
The mod will be worked upon, and the final two resolution categories are to be added in future updates, stay tuned!
Also, if you have any issues with balancing or suggestions for additional resolutions, also do let me know, I highly appreciate your feedback :)

The automations that are currently available and optional:
[list]
[*][b]Auto colony manager:[/b] Enabling this automation will make a new button available when a planet is selected that brings up a menu. This menu currently includes auto planetary decisions and auto construct buildings and districts.

[*][b]Auto fleet/army merger:[/b] Enabling this automation will automatically merge fleets or armies that were present (built) at the time of this being enabled.

[*][b]Auto pop migration:[/b] Enabling this automation will automatically resettle unemployed pops to planets that have free jobs at the usual cost. There is also an option for it to resettle to the Synaptic Lathe.

[*][b]Auto construct megastructures:[/b] Enabling this automation will make a new button appear on the left side of the screen whenever a construction ship is selected. The button will make the construction ship automatically construct megastructures as many as it's allowed (capped). This feature currently includes Hyper Relays, Gateways, Orbital Rings, Dyson Swarms, Arc Furnace, Habitats, and Deep Space Citadels. It also includes all 3 Frameworld megastructures from Gigastructures.

[*][b]Auto recruit armies:[/b] Enabling this automation will automatically recruit the chosen army on every owned planet until disabled.

[*][b]Auto construct outposts:[/b] Enabling this automation will make a new button appear on the left side of the screen whenever a construction ship is selected. The button will make the construction ship automatically construct outposts.

[*][b]Auto fleet attack:[/b] Enabling this automation will make a new button appear on the left side of the screen whenever a fleet is selected. The button will make the selected fleet automatically attack the nearest enemy and/or bombard planets with the bombardment stance selected from the settings. It can also be set to only attack fleets within empire borders.

[*][b]Auto army invade:[/b] Enabling this automation will automatically set all armies to Aggressive Stance and invade hostile planets, if the odds of success are favourable. This can also be set to auto invade primitives.

[*][b]Auto recruit leaders:[/b] Enabling this automation will automatically recruit and assign the chosen leaders.

[*][b]Auto planet destroyer:[/b] Enabling this automation will make all planet destroyers automatically destroy the nearest hostile planet that is within a neighboring system.

[*][b]Auto colonisation:[/b] Enabling this automation will automatically build a colony ship and colonise the nearest planet with a chosen habitability or more.

[*][b]Auto upgrade megastructures:[/b] Enabling this automation will automatically upgrade megastructures (Gigastructures, ACOT, and NSC included).

[*][b]Auto terraforming:[/b] Enabling this automation will automatically terraform planets to the planet type that was chosen in the settings.

[*][b]Auto upgrade deep space citadels:[/b] Enabling this automation will automatically upgrade all deep space citadels.

[*][b]Auto outfit starbases:[/b] Enabling this automation will make a new button appear on the left side of the screen whenever a starbase is selected. When the button is clicked, a menu will appear with multiple options to automatically outfit the starbase with a predefined template. This automation is also NSC compatible.

[*][b]Auto upgrade/manage starbases:[/b] Enabling this automation will automatically upgrade a starbase once per month (or faster) from a specified level in the settings. The upgrading of outposts will stop once the starbase cap is reached. All starbases can also be downgraded simultaneously from a specified level using the options.
[/list]
All these options are accessible through a shortcut 'Y' or the dedicated button and can be enabled using the ever so shiny main menu.

- A new automation "Auto upgrade deep space citadels" has been added!
- The automation "Auto construct outposts", "Auto construct megastructures", "Auto outfit starbases", "Auto upgrade starbases", "Auto upgrade Deep Space Citadels" now have a month countdown counter to show progress!
- The automation "Auto construct megastructures" was the only automation that did not account for any build speed reductions but now it does.
- Lastly, general bug fixes.

This update took absolutely ages but hopefully everything works; if you find any bugs, let me know!

[b]Currently in progress:[/b]
- Loads of things that I choose on a whim haha (from the list).

- Auto slave marketing.
- Auto agendas.
- Expanded automation for planets.
- Auto market/resource manager.
- Auto reverse engineering of minor artefacts.
- Reworking "Auto terraforming".
- Add resource limits to some of the automation e.g., only use this much alloy and once depleted, player can reset it.
- and more!

Plus any suggestions from discussions or comments.
If you have a suggestion or an idea, then please comment or leave a post in the discussions.

- English
- Brazilian Portuguese (machine translated).

- Not achievement compatible.
- Fully compatible with other mods* but should be prioritised over other UI mods due to button; so placed last in the load order (at the bottom). 
- Save compatible but should disable and enable automation features after an update.

*Apart from Compact UI Top-bar.

- The automation "Auto fleet merger" being a bit weird/flaky.

[h1]New Megastructure:[/h1] Resource Silo. Adds mineral and energy resource storage to your empire.

[h1]New Strategic Resource:[/h1]Supertensile Solids. These give a modest boost to megastructure build speed, and spaceport health.

[h1]New Ascension Perk:[/h1]Forge Worlds. Unlocks Space Elevators, Equatorial Shipyards and the Planet Cracker.


[b]Upcoming Features:[/b]

-Galactic HAROLD. HAROLD. HAROLD. HAROLD. We actually mean harold. Not Herald. What would a galactic herald even do? *fanfare* tada! It's... the galaxy! No, we really do mean Galactic Harold.
-Society-based Megastructure Projects (secrets!).
-Planet-cracking. **Now Added**
-Communications Array.
-Diplomatic Conference Basilica
-Ethics based projects (maybe.)
-More stuff.

German - credit to Killy84

Any mods that alter system scale, or the scale of Ringworld parts will currently cause visual issues, such as the location of our megastructures in relation to planets etc. 

Please report bugs below, and have fun. This mod will be receiving frequent updates over the coming days/weeks.

title: More Precursors
description:
This mod adds 3 new precursors: The Ixardian Corporation, The Werediran Signal and The Ezentian Combine.

Each Precursor comes with their own relic, secrets and precursor technology.

[h1] The Ezentian Combine [/h1]

A broken planet has been found, and all evidence points towards it being an intentional act by its previous owners. But what empire would destroy one of their own planets?

[h1] The Ixardian Corporation [/h1]

A megacorporation that held sway over most of the galactic economy less than a million years ago. Now all that remains are a few buildings among the ruins of yet more ancient and forgotten empires.

[h1] The Werediran Signal [/h1]

A radio signal that has traveled through the void for millennia leads to a world that was once the home to a thriving society who also picked up the signal. It appears as if their downfall coincided with that event.

[h1] Mods With Gameplay interaction [/h1]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2916982793] Forgotten History [/url] is a mod that adds the archeology tradition tree and the archivist enclave, both of which interacts with the base game precursors along with modded precursors from this mod and the precursor story pack mod.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3039370479] Precursor Selection [/url] My own take on a precursor selection mod.

[strike][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1780597499] Known Precursor [/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/owarme] Oskar [/url] enables you to choose which precursor(s) you want to get, including precursors from this mod.[/strike] Outdated. Please use Precursor Selection instead.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3275068730]More Astral Rifts[/url] has an astral rift about one of this mod's precursors.

[h2] Translations [/h2]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3120786119] Japanese Localization [/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198099426560]Bee634[/url]

This mod adds two new tiers of strategic resource refinery buildings to the game, they function the same as the vanilla refineries except with higher output and upkeep costs. It also adds buildings that increase the output of metallurgist and artisan (alloys and consumer goods) jobs at the cost of increased resource upkeep.

Be aware the upkeep costs of these jobs can start to get pretty expensive if all these buildings are used together. It is generally useful to maximize production on specialized colonies such as forge worlds where the various stacking bonuses can be used to help to offset the exorbitant upkeep costs, as well as maximise the output of said buildings.

description:
[h1]Transparency[/h1]
This mod is maintained as a spare-time project. I use AI-assisted tools such as Codex/ChatGPT for compatibility work, cleanup tasks, and the supplemental name pool.

All files are still reviewed locally before publishing. Testing is limited and focuses on obvious compatibility issues, file conflicts, and basic in-game validation. Very large galaxies can still be unstable depending on system performance, game version, load order, and other active mods.

[h1]Overview[/h1]

[/table]

[h2]Gameplay Notes[/h2]
Very large galaxies can heavily impact performance and stability. The two biggest sizes may crash your game.

Sizes smaller than vanilla "Tiny" use the same restricted galaxy shape selections as Tiny.

Regular empire caps are intentionally kept per size for stability and setup balance. Custom sizes also define Stellaris 4.4 Nomad empire defaults and maximum values so the new setup values are read correctly.

[h1]Names[/h1]
Earlier versions included [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/kaseyawolf2]Kaseyawolf2's[/url] Mod '10 000 star names'. The current version no longer includes that list directly; it uses a cleaned-up custom name pool plus additional AI-assisted names for very large galaxies.

The old numbered fallback names were removed. The supplemental name pool is intended to reduce missing or repetitive names, especially for stars and black holes.

Generated black hole names now include localisation so they should display as readable names instead of raw localisation keys.

If you have a curated list of star or black hole names and want to contribute, feel free to contact me.

Vanilla has space elves, so I made space pixies.

[h1]Contents[/h1]

[b]Animated Portrait Set[/b]
Animated humanoid set. They twitch, and blink, and look around, and breathe, just like vanilla portraits. They have different skins, faces, sexual dimorphism, different clothes, and several different hairstyles and clothes.

[b]Custom City Set[/b]
Spunky neon purple city, based on the mammalian set.

[b]Custom Name List[/b]
Generic xeno-humanoid name list, completely new.

[b]Custom Starting Solar System[/b]
The Taxeema system, a simple, clean start on a temperate world with two small sea moons, orbiting a yellow sun.

[b]Custom AI Personality[/b]
If my Custom Empire (and only that one) of Xirmians is moved by the AI, it will acquire by default the Flamboyant Diplomats personality. It makes the AI focus on speed and shields for his ships, and be very open to trade and diplomacy. Yet, unlike vanilla “peaceful” personalities, Flamboyant Diplomats will still partake in war and Nation-building occasionally. The personality is also paired with about 50 new lines of dialogue for the various diplomatic messages, which provide multiple reactions for each vanilla species_class.
If you use my Custom Empire, you'll still have access to some of this content through the tailored custom insults that your diplomat will be able to send to other empires. 

[b]Custom Empire[/b]
The Xirmian Astral Concordate. It’s a Direct Democracy, xenophile/materialist/individualist. Since this mod does not add any gameplay, I’ve set this Empire as capable of spawning on its own (although it won’t spawn always), unless the player is using it, in which case it will never spawn.
If you wish to disable the Empire from spawning without using it yourself, you need to either disable the mod before starting up Stellaris, or go to the mod folder (Steam/SteamApps/workshop/content/281990/... /xirmian_portraits/prescripted_countries/) open the xirmian_prescripted_countries file, search for spawn_enabled=yes, and edit it to: spawn_enabled=no.

title: Smarter Hyper Relays: Improved AI (shrimpAI)
description:
Smarter AI for building hyper relays

Does the AI seem a little haphazard when building hyper relays? And then builds them more-or-less everywhere? This mod fixes that.

With this mod, AI empires build proper networks starting at capitals, branching to sector capitals, then to other colonies.

[h1]Details[/h1]
Every year, this mod finds and marks the shortest path from capitals to sector capitals, and from sector capitals to sector colonies. Paths to wormholes/gateways/catapults and border fortresses are also found (from sector capital if in a sector, otherwise from empire capital). A path along an existing relay is considered twice as short, to encourage the AI to re-use existing relays. The AI then only builds relays in systems that border an existing relay they own and are on one of those paths, with the following exceptions:
[list]
 [*] The empire's capital (this let's them get their network started)
 [*] Sector capitals that are at least 10 years old and have no path to the capital (this let's them build a separate network if they have a non-contiguous empire, for example on the other side of a wormhole)
[/list]

Overlords will build paths to the their subject capitals, and will build paths through subjects if they have an isolated sector on the other side.

In addition to normal building of hyper relays using construction ships, the AI gets to build up to 1 hyper relay each year without using a construction ship. They still pay the resources for it, and only do it if they have a large stockpile of resources (10x the required resources). This is to address 2 vanilla issues with the AI:
[list]
 [*] The AI isn't good at managing it's construction ships, sometimes sending one from the east side of it's empire all the way build something in the west, while at the same time sending a one from the west to build in the east, wasting months or even years. This "cheat" helps make up for lost time.
 [*] Sometimes, especially after unlocking other megastructures, the AI stops building hyper relays, even if their resource stockpiles are completely full. This "cheat" lets AIs with strong economies continue expanding their relay networks into the late game.
[/list]

This has been tested for performance on a huge galaxy and has no noticeable impact.

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
[list]
  [*] For Stellaris 4.4.*
  [*] NOT achievement compatible
  [*] Can be added to an existing game, but works best if the AI has not started building hyper relays yet
  [*] Can be removed from an existing game
  [*] Compatible with Gigastructural Engineering and More (load order does not matter)
  [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3241944359]shrimpAI for Total Conversions is a separate version that provides compatibility for some total conversion mods[/url]
  [*] Compatible with Sparsity and Wild Space 3 (enables building hyper relays in unclaimable space for both player and AI; load order does not matter)
  [list]
    [*] To retain the cheaper Hyper Relay costs of Sparsity, use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2842476749]Cheaper Relays Submod[/url]
  [/list]
  [*] Should be compatible with all other mods, except other mods that override hyper relays
  [list]
    [*] Note for patch makers: this only overrides the hyper_relay megastructure, and within that, only changes the ai_weight
  [/list]
[/list]

[h1]Sharing[/h1]
Feel free to update, pack, patch, translate, fork, or incorporate this mod, no prior permission required. Credit, linking to the original mod, and letting me know is appreciated!

title: Legendary Worlds 3.2.x ONLY
description:
3.3 update here will be avaiable soon, updated by original author

Legendary Worlds 3.2.2
Updated with the kind permission of the author.
Original mod here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1373224279

Updated Planetary Diversity compatibility.
General pass on the modifiers/triggers.
Tweaks here and there.
APSR mod compatibility.
GPM mod compatibility.


Bugs are bound to happen, lemme know if you find any. I'm not a great modder in any way but it'll try to sort it out.
Also, sugestions on new modifiers or changes to existing ones are always welcome.

WIP:
Implementation of archaeology dig sites to provide legendary modifiers.
Updating Legendary Ocean planet modifiers to account Aquiatic Species additions.



Legendary Worlds


This mods adds special planets (legendary worlds) by giving them a planet modifier. Most of them will have a huge buff on certain areas. Planets on vanilla are mostly the same and this feels boring. So this mod adds a planet variety and diversity in a special way, not completely overhauling everything. It can change a lot of balance, but it still does not feel game-breaking. If you find two extra good vanilla worlds of your type in early that can be quite unbalanced too. The chances are very small, but if you are lucky and find a legendary world next to your homeworld it makes you a lucky one. Since 2.2 update, all major bonus legendary modifiers are balanced in a way you will enjoy them if you find them early or near your homeworld, but it will take a lot of efforts to fully unlock their capabilities. This is the mostly big Change within the 2.2. update.

Also there are three "different" world classes:

Common and Uncommon Legendaries

There is a set of three rather common legendary planets and a lot more that occur more often (about 1 of 20 planets). One for each climate: Ocean, Continental and Tropical worlds can get a food bonus, cold weather planets can get a mineral bonus and hot climate planets can get a energy bonus. So every empire will get a unique bonus once colonized enough worlds of their type. These are rather minor buffs, compared to other legendaries.

Rare Legendaries

There are lot of very powerful modifiers, that most planets can get on random. They are really rare, and in a small galaxy you might have only 1 or 2 of this kind in the whole game. So if you play several games, you will find a new legendary from time to time. Here legendary buffs are quite decent and very unique, but most of it will only shine from the mid-game on. So if you find one these in the early game, you will find it very hard to use them unless you got more advanced technology or generally more income to make a expense for getting a colony up here.

True Legendaries

True legendary Worlds are the rarest of all Worlds. It could happen that there will be not even a single planet within the whole Galaxy. This can happen even on 1000 stars Maps, but its more unlikely. Their bonuses are mighty ones, for which Empires will fight to death. Find them and ensure them for your empire!


Ancients and Buildings

This mod adds a fallen precursor race, called ancients (very creative, i know). You can find buildings from them randomly on any world (doesn't have to a legendary world). If you are more lucky you can even find a whole ancient colony with more special ancients buildings. Rumors say that there can also spawn an ancient homeworld from time to time.
All other new buildings added within this mod belong to a special legendary, so they can only be built on those worlds. That's because i dont want to add more "everywhere buildable" buildings to the game, as they are more than plenty on the workshop.

Included

30 new legendary modifier
19 new special Buildings
8 new specialst jobs
5 new survey events
3 new technologies
3 new mini Events
a lot of unique planet tiles


Compatibility

Compatible with all DLC.
DLCs not required.
Language files for every language included. (all texts english only)

No vanilla files were harmed during the modding process. Should be fully compatible with almost any mod.
However there can only be ONE file in the game for borders of planet modifiers. Any mod which alters this file, will consult in small graphic bug (you wont see the legendary borders around a planetary modifier).

Guillis Planet Modifier: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=865040033

I made my file for border_frames to be fully compatible with both mods and Guilliman has replaced his file with mine. So this both mods have 100% compability despite using the same ressources. Thanks to him for adapting his mod!


Full compatibility with Planetary Diversity

Have Fun finding all legendaries :)

I have tested every legendary ingame, they all did their job working. But i am no modding expert, so please feel free to report any bugs/strange behaviors as they occur, and i will see what i can do.

Spawn frequency has really a lot of random modifiers and are also dependend on spawned planet classes. Different games may have different spawn rates of legendaries.

Updates
V2.4:
Minor balancing changes regarding Timeshifted Planets.
Increased Bonus for Basic Legendary Mining Planets.

V2.3:
Added some new Modifiers as well a huge balance update.
(Detailed description lost to the imba-gay-new-♥♥♥♥-game launcher)

Be aware that legendary modifiers will only spawn at game start (some days afterwards). You can safley add this mod to a savegame, but you can get only legedaries from terraforming or megastructures. Not going to change that!

title: Cheek's Custom Shipsets: Star Trek [Federation]
description:
[h1]Stellaris. The final frontier...[/h1]

Introducing my own Star Trek themed shipset, with over 50 custom models and textures depicting ships from Star Trek!

Star Trek has had a long history of kitbashing: creating new ships designs by reusing older models and rearranging the parts. Each ship class, with the exception of the corvette, frigates and juggernaut, has been split into sections just like vanilla shipsets. This allows you to mix-and-match parts to make your own designs!

Destroyers are split into Saucer and Nacelles, while Cruisers, Battleships and Titans are divided by Saucer, Hull and Nacelles.

As well as the ships, this shipset adds new Station models. Eventually I plan to update this mod to include Megastructures.

description:
[b]Updated and working with Stellaris version 3.4 ("Cepheus" update).[/b]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list][*]All of the Backgrounds+ mods in a single package.
[*]Including: 'Loading Screens,' 'Leaders,' 'Planet View,' and 'Anomalies.'
[/list]


[h1]FAQs[/h1]
[b]Is it Ironman / achievement compatible?[/b]
[i]Yes, this mod is completely compatible to earn you achievements if you play with it—on any game version.[/i]

[b]Can I have the vanilla backgrounds too?[/b]
[i]Yes you can! See [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1545833973]this mod[/url] for more info.[/i]

[b]Is this compatible with other mods?[/b]
[i]This mod should be compatible with pretty much everything that does not edit the vanilla "event_pictures" files. If a mod that adds new event pictures and anomaly pictures that does not edit the vanilla ones and just adds files used by the mod, everything should be okay. However, if a mod uses vanilla "event_pictures" files, then that change will be reflected by the mod. ---- ie. the More Events Mod, uses the vanilla "event_pictures" and so, with this mod installed, would use the ones from the mod, which may conflict with the context or mood/theme.[/i]

[b]Who made these and am I able to download any of the backgrounds?[/b]
[i]Some of the images & artwork are made by [url=https://www.artstation.com/vadimsadovski]Vadim Sadovski[/url], and converted for Stellaris by QUENTOPOLIS. Check out his work and download the images [url=https://www.artstation.com/vadimsadovski]here[/url]. All images & artwork are made by various artists, and converted for Stellaris by QUENTOPOLIS. I, in no way, shape or form, own any credit to the making of the images used within the mod.[/i]


[h1]If you like the mod, make sure to rate it and favorite it![/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]

[i]See more of Q's work at [url=https://www.quentopolis.com/]quentopolis.com[/url][/i]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/quentopolis][img]https://i.imgur.com/3M3Daqg.png?1[/img][/url]

title: [4.4]Galactic Imperium Origin
description:
Welcome to our [url=https://discord.gg/ySsPYbPgZP]discord[/url].

[h1]Introduce[/h1]
This mod offers a range of new origins, allowing players to experience a mid-game start where Galactic Imperium has already been established.

[h1]2025/6/19 Update[/h1]
-Secondary Hegemony origin is back.

[h1]Galactic Sovereign[/h1]
-Start game as Galactic Emperor.(AI with this origin will also become the emperor,so if you want to become the rebel, you can lock an AI with this origin) 
-At the start of the game, countries start with borders already formed. All countries join the Galactic Imperium, with the exception of those with Hegemon or Common Ground origins, and those that are not capable of cooperation, such as exterminator machines, hive-devourers, fanatic purifiers, and others..
-Countries with Hegemon or Common Ground Origin keep their respective federations, do not join the Galactic Imperium and get a special national policy that provides huge bonuses.
-Each country will receive a lot of resources and a huge bonus to the construction speed within 5 years of the game, allowing them to quickly improve their economic system.
-The emperor will get a magnificent Ecumenopolis and several planets that provide basic resource output. If multiple countries have this origin, all these countries will receive these rewards, but only one will become the emperor.

[h1]Galactic Custodian[/h1]
-Start the game as the Custodian.(It is still valid for AI to have this origin)
-At the start of the game, countries start with borders already formed. All countries join the Galactic Community, with the exception of those that are not capable of cooperation, such as exterminator machines, hive-devourers, fanatic purifiers, and others...
-Each nation will receive massive resources and a huge bonus to construction speed, allowing them to quickly improve their economy.
-Custodian has more territory and two additional planets.

[h1]Other Origins[/h1]
Old Alliance：As an important ally in international cooperation with the Emperor long before the unification of the galaxy, the country was granted a permanent seat in the Imperial Council after the establishment of the Galactic Imperium.
Monopoly Chaebol：This megacorp seized the moment, invested in its greatest project, the unification of the galaxy, and received its own reward. Now, the market across the galaxy is opening up to them.
Galactic Nemesis：This civilization are would-be harbingers of galactic doom, backed by unknowable powers.
Herald of the Apocalypse：Before entering space, this civilization had been selected by the patron from the shroud as the devastator of the galaxy.
Secondary Hegemon：This civilization forged its hegemony against the Galactic Empire. Although its sphere of influence is small, it has a strong control over the areas under its jurisdiction.

[h1]Other Features[/h1]
Provides the Emperor and Custodian with a new casus belli: intervention. This can be used against members who violate galactic laws or wage civil war within the Imperium under high authority, turning them into vassals.
-The Emperor and external federations has unique casus belli against each other.
Also try my [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2774987343]Imperial Tax Mod[/url].
If you enjoy this mod, you can buy me a cup of coffee：[url=https://ko-fi.com/hathaway682]here[/url].

🛠️ Fixed the bug that the effect of Subterfuge Traditions Finished didn't work.

🛠️ Fixed the bug where AI empires could incorrectly leave a Hegemony federation without the President's permission.
(This fix is currently unverified - please let me know if the issue persists.)

🛠️ Bug fixes and improvements in rationality to the pacifist resolutions of Galactic Community: The Toxifier and Devolving Beam will now correctly violate the corresponding Galactic Laws. The using of Armageddon, Indiscriminate Bombardment, and World Cracker and so on to a Crisis Faction(including Endgame Crisis, the countries that had been declared Crisis and the countries that had any "Become the Crisis" AP and had Crisis Level 5) will no longer violate the Galactic Laws. If Crisis is ongoing, Demobilization Initiative(the final resolution in the pacifist path) will no longer prohibit Militarized Economy policy. Last Resort Doctrine and Demobilization Initiative will now also provide a 25% shipbuilding speed bonus during a Crisis(they boost shipbuilding speed in defensive wars with great determination - and if a galactic Crisis isn’t a defensive war, what is? :) ).

🛠️ Added the missing conditions and weights for Cosmogenesis and Behemoth Fury to AI Will in Galactic Community resolutions.(Paradox just forgot it.)

🛠️ Added the missing conditions and weights for Custodian-related resolution to AI Will in Galactic Community.(Paradox just forgot it.)

🛠️ AI will now use Edicts and Campaigns other than those that consume Unity.(The bug that has always existed in vanilla, and the 3.9 has affected more.)

🛠️ The situation of "What is to be our fate" from Shroudwalker Enclave will now correctly end after when it caused no result.(In vanilla, it won't, because Paradox forgot, again.)

🛠️ The AI country with Civic Autonomous Drones or Sovereign Circuits will now normally recruit leaders instead of being in a daze.(In vanilla, they still don't understand how to use Energy, Food or Minerals for a leaders' upkeep.)

🛠️ The Origin Payback, the event Healthcare Crisis will now be correctly avoided after Gene Clinic has been repaired.(In vanilla, the lack of trigger condition led to the triggering of "Healthcare Crisis" even if Gene Clinic was repaired and the tech was obtained.)

🛠️ (I assume Paradox has already fixed this, so this has been temporarily removed. If the issue still exists, please let me know.) Machine Intelligence Empires will no longer vainly and repeatedly assimilate their main species (after synthetic evolution), resulting in massive unemployment and economic collapse.(The malicious bug added in the vanilla 3.6 is the primary culprit that led to the collapse of the Machine Empires in the mid to late stages. However, because players usually pay little attention to the details of AI, they are rarely noticed. In fact, it occurs almost 100%.)

🛠️ (I assume Paradox has already fixed this, so this has been temporarily removed. If the issue still exists, please let me know.) Ditto, Organic Empires, too.

🛠️ The Admiral you obtained in event Promising Officer will now had the corresponding trait if you had Civic Crusader Spirit or Letters of Marque.

🛠️ When releasing a sector as a vassal, if you are in the Federation and federal law allows vassals to join, the released vassal will correctly automatically sign a commercial pact upon joining the Federation.(In vanilla, when a country joins any federation, it will automatically sign a commercial pact with its members. The vassals formed by the release of sectors may have been generated directly within the federation, mistakenly bypassing the judgement of joining the federation and failing to automatically sign, and you cannot actively sign with it, resulting in a loss of production.)

🛠️ In The War in Heaven, AI will no longer make illogical votes in Galactic Community.(In vanilla, AI will always trying denouncing one side and The League of Non-Aligned Powers even which they belong.)

🛠️ In Denounce Both resolution in The War in Heaven, AI belong to any side of Awakened Empires will no longer display a exact opposite voting reason, but a correct one.(In vanilla, AI will incorrectly display "They are not part of an Awakened Fallen Empire" even actually they are.)

🛠️ The resolution "A United Front" will now increase the damage done to the Great Khan. Accordingly, the damage bonus of resolution "Anti-Piracy Initiative" to Khan has been removed.(In vanilla, AI will always trying passing "A United Front" when Khan awakened, but the resolution has no effect to Khan but reduce Energy production.)

🛠️ When any member of the federation is Market Leader, other members will now no longer always resolutely oppose the resolution to relocate Galactic Market if it is proposed by a member of the federation.(In vanilla, this unreasonably prevented you from relocating Market Hub within the federation.)

🛠️ The Uplifting event of the Enigmatic Cache, when the initial template of the main species has the traits Intelligent and Quick Learners, will correctly no longer trigger the worse outcome Ignorance Is Bliss.(In vanilla, the criteria for determining the outcome of this event were incorrectly coupled, resulting in a loss of meaning, and the possibility of triggering Ignorance Is Bliss could never be avoided.)

🛠️ In addition, possessing the advanced trait Erudite and their corresponding traits of Overtuned version will also avoid triggering the worse outcome Ignorance Is Bliss.(The content that should be updated that had forgotten by Paradox.)

🛠️ Further, with these traits, Nightmare events will now no longer trigger when uplifting.(The content that should be updated that had forgotten by Paradox.)

🛠️ Corrected the description of the First League Homeworld, now will no longer wrongly states that "It no longer supports life".(Because in old version, this is a planet can't be colonized.)

🛠️ (Paradox has fixed this)Xenophobe and Fanatic Xenophobe empires can no longer incorrectly have the ability to grant full citizenship to aliens. (Paradox intended for Xenophobe empires with the Synthetic Fertility Origin to grant full citizenship to robots, but a coding mistake caused a series of checks to apply exclusively to robots instead. Another funny bug.)
Similarly, Xenophobe and Fanatic Xenophobe empires can no longer incorrectly have the ability to grant full military service to aliens.

🛠️ (Paradox has fixed this)And, if your main species had the advanced trait "Erudite", the Admiral will also correctly have it, just like "Cybernetic" or "Psychic".(In vanilla, even if all your pops had the trait "Erudite", the Admiral you obtained in this event would still not have it.)

🛠️ (Paradox has fixed this)The Civic "Scavengers" can now salvage and repair Frigates.(In vanilla, Frigates can't be salvaged, obviously Paradox forgot that they had added a new ship size.)

🛠️ (Paradox has fixed this) The trait "Agrarian" of overtuned version will now correctly provide double bonus when the edict "Damn the Consequences" be activated.(In vanilla has no effect.)

🛠️ (Paradox has fixed this) The trait "Conservationist" of overtuned version will now correctly provide -10% consumer goods upkeep instead of +15%.(Yes...and it will double to +30% when the edict be activated in vanilla!!)
